newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan stocks end softer, volume stays high.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan stocks end softer, volume stays high.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed slightly lower on Monday but turnover stayed high aided by foreign buying of blue chips, brokers said.
The all share index ended at 558.10, down 0.60 points from Friday. Development Finance Corp fell two rupees to 263 and Kelani Cables 1.25 to 30.
"There are times when you can find sellers in bulk, and match them with buyers," Ralph Wijesinghe of Asia Securities said. Brokers suggested there was redemption by a foreign fund.
Turnover rose to 31.70 million rupees from a daily average of less than 15 million in August.
